preconditions.description: The input string length is between 1 and 1,000,000 (inclusive), representing the number of children in the line.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'M', 'F'} for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string is either 'M' (boy) or 'F' (girl).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of seconds needed to move all girls in front of boys.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == 0 if all(c == 'F' for c in stdin.strip()) or all(c == 'M' for c in stdin.strip()) else int(stdout.strip()) == max(0, sum(i for i, c in enumerate(stdin.strip()) if c == 'F' and i < next((j for j in range(i+1, len(stdin.strip())) if stdin.strip()[j] == 'M'), len(stdin.strip()))))
postconditions.description: The output is 0 if the line consists entirely of girls or entirely of boys. Otherwise, it is the maximum number of swaps (seconds) required for any girl to move past all boys initially to her left, where a swap occurs when a boy is immediately in front of a girl.
